assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: full-width desktop application header background for Dragonfire. A black dragon glides horizontally over the right half of the horizon, small enough to fit a shallow banner. Lava glows through bronze-black battlements, ash clouds and drifting embers. Visible designed scenery and texture across the ENTIRE left, middle and right, no blank black left half or fadeout. Keep important object shapes small and horizontally extended; atmospheric room above and below. Rich cinematic detail, thin glows, no glaring white flares, no foreground character, no giant circular object cropped at the top. Full bleed illustration only, not a screenshot, contact sheet, frame or moodboard.
